final: WITH t AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, n AS distinct_orders, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM t) AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM t) AS ratio_to_avg FROM t
